description: We are team BunBo_KoHanh from Ho Chi Minh City! Our goal is to build an engaging, retro-styled web strategy game where players step into the shoes of a NASA Flight Director—making tough mission design trade-offs, managing budgets, and handling space crises. We're looking for passionate teammates with skills in UI/UX design, creative storytelling, or space science to join us and bring this interactive experience to life!
